title: 第七章 修仙不是打打杀杀那都是人情世故第八章 丹药组合技给修炼提提速
slug: 看守废丹房三年我偷偷成仙了
lines: 众人齐齐倒吸一口凉气。
好特么疼！
这一下子，怕不是直接把人干废了。
这秦凡什么时候变得这么生猛了？
若是没看错，刚才他好像展现出了炼气四层的修为气势。
这个境界，已足够他晋升外门弟子了。
凭他的天赋，他是怎么做到的？
难道他是个仙二代，只是一直低调行事？
然后现在不装了，摊牌了？
孟祥辉和王大彪也懵了。
这特么是秦凡？
不会是让人给夺舍了吧！
陈恒落地之后，又是一口鲜血吐出。
一张脸，已黑如锅底。
不是形容，是“物理”上的黑。
头发眉毛脸以及胸前衣襟，全都被烧焦烧糊了。
怎一个凄惨了得。
“不，不可能，这不可能……”
陈恒不敢相信，完全无法接受。想他堂堂杂役金字塔尖的人物，竟会败给一个吊车尾？
假的，一定是假的。
肯定是早上吃菌子汤吃出了幻觉。
说实话，秦凡也没想到他火球术的威力这么大。
不过转念一想，一层境界一层天。
加上陈恒没防备，打出这种效果也还算正常。
诧异过后，秦凡露出淡淡笑容，随即又轻轻一叹。
这一声叹息，将所有人的视线都吸引了过来。
只见秦凡摇了摇头，颇为无奈的道：“昨日一拳击败王大彪师兄，今日又一招将陈师兄打倒在地，偌大的杂役峰，竟无人是我一合之敌吗？唉，如此无趣的比试，当真是寂寞如雪啊。”
尼玛，逼都让你装完了。
content_en:
"Hiss!"
Everyone gasped in unison.
It hurts so much!
This time, I'm afraid I might have killed him directly.
When did Qin Fan become so fierce?
If you read it correctly, he seemed to have displayed the aura of cultivation at the fourth level of Qi Refining just now.
This level is enough for him to be promoted to an outer disciple.
With his talent, how did he do it?
Could it be that he is a second-generation immortal who just keeps a low profile?
And now you stop pretending and have a showdown?
Meng Xianghui and Wang Dabiao were also stunned.
What the hell is this Qin Fan?
Wouldn't it be possible for someone to seize the body?
"Poof!"
After Chen Heng landed on the ground, he spat out another mouthful of blood.
His face was as black as the bottom of a pot.
It's not a description, it's "physically" black.
His hair, eyebrows, face, and chest were all burnt to ashes.
How miserable.
"No, it's impossible, it's impossible..."
Chen Heng couldn't believe it and couldn't accept it at all. To think that he, a man at the top of the handyman pyramid, would be defeated by a low-level person?
If it's fake, it must be fake.
It must have been the hallucination caused by the mushroom soup I ate in the morning.
To be honest, Qin Fan didn't expect his fireball technique to be so powerful.
But then I thought about it, one level of realm and one level of heaven.
In addition, Chen Heng was unprepared, so this effect was quite normal.
After being surprised, Qin Fan showed a faint smile, and then sighed softly.
"Alas."
This sigh attracted everyone's attention.
Qin Fan shook his head and said rather helplessly: "Yesterday I defeated Senior Brother Wang Dabiao with one punch, and today I knocked Senior Brother Chen to the ground with another move. Is there anyone in the huge Miscellaneous Peak who can be my enemy? Alas, such a boring competition is really as lonely as snow."
Damn it, you've finished pretending.
title_en: Chapter 7: Cultivation of immortality is not about fighting and killing, it is all about human nature. Chapter 8: Combination of pills to speed up cultivation.
